Wanli Emperor at the age of 13.
[2] The grand secretary

Jinyiwei with authority over 1,000 households as a result of his daughter's success. In 1579, the Wanli Emperor also conferred the rank of 
Count (伯) of 
Yongnian on him.
[4] Since the time of the 
Jiajing Emperor, inheritance of a feudal title by 
lineal descendants was not permitted. To show favour to Wang Xijie, her brother Wang Dong (王棟) was granted the countship on their father's death. When Wang Dong died, his mother Lady Zhao (趙) begged the emperor to extend the countship to Wang Dong's children, which was promptly done. Only the family of 
Empress Dowager Xiaoding had previously received similar honours.
